MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: dwellings
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Visualizes the density of pawn dwellings across the planet.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: age structure
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shades each region by the median age of its people, from youthful green to elderly red.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: sex ratio
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shades each region by its sex balance — blue where men outnumber women, magenta where women outnumber men, neutral where it is even.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: xenotypes
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Tints each region by its dominant xenotype, darker where that caste dominates more strongly. Needs Biotech; without it every pawn is Baseliner.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: education
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shades each region by its education index, from an unschooled brown to a highly-educated blue.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: wealth
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shades each region by its socioeconomic index, from a poor deep red to an affluent green.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: ideology
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Tints each region by its dominant ideoligion in that ideo's own colour, darker where belief is more uniform. Needs the Ideology DLC; without it every region is secular.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: employment
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Tints each region by its dominant occupation sector — green agriculture, steel industry, red military, gold trade — darker where that sector dominates more.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Territories
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Visualizes national domains and zones of control, shaded by owning faction.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Regions and Societies
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Visualizes world analytics from Regions and Societies (dropdown list).
